name: fold-run-over-ticket
why: Fold 1: a live run is THE row for the concern it works. Without it the queue shows a running row and, beside it, that same ticket reading as plain untouched work - two rows for one concern, and the reader re-drives what is already in hand. #5 has no run, so it keeps its own row: the fold is scoped to the concern being worked, not to the repo.

expected.detail: resolve #4 in progress: The header collapses
